faq.q: What cosmetic surface defect standards apply to Titanium Smart Glasses Temple Arm?
faq.a: Titanium Smart Glasses Temple Arm is inspected to consumer electronics cosmetic standards: no visible scratches >0.1 mm width under 500 lux illumination at 30 cm viewing distance.
